description: Enhancing the anime girl's appearance with subtle side details.
The left rook of the castle, previously hidden, is now visible from the front-side.
The crocodile’s upper jaw may seem small, so we exaggerated it from the front to enhance its threat.
The plane looked too rigid, so we gave it a more dynamic, "mid-flight" appearance.
We made the bulldozer larger to enhance its sense of strength and authority.
